description: Image Description: The image features a group of three bighorn sheep in a snowy, forested environment. Two of the sheep are standing close to each other, appearing to interact. The sheep have thick, beige-colored fur with some visible patches where the fur is shedding. They are on a snow-covered ground with scattered rocks and sparse vegetation. In the background, there is a dense forest of evergreen trees, and a partially visible body of water with a bluish tint, suggesting a cold climate.
